# Ministry city catalog

191 city identifiers/names extracted from db.json in the MIT-licensed repository:
https://github.com/creskopper/habous-prayer-times-api
Pinned revision: ca1154c14e0042c785a6ed3cff091181c22dfd1d

Only city identifiers and labels were reused. No prayer rows, date-conversion code, HTTP code, or audio were copied. Native monthly parser, storage and Android jobs were written for Wird.
The catalog contains two entries named تاهلة (94 and 303); both are downloaded by ID.
Ministry source: https://habous.gov.ma/prieres/
This is the full bundled source list, not a claim to cover every Moroccan settlement.
Current monthly tables are downloaded from the Ministry on the phone, not synthesized from the catalog.
